items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 92:1
items.html: Sleep and slumber mean: the ascent to MAN. For at the time that the Mochin ascend as MAN, and the Partzuf remains below without Mochin, it is discerned as sleeping, like a sleeping man whose brains are not revealed at that time. And for this very reason, the birth of the Mochin and their return to clothe in the Partzuf is called his awakening from his sleep. Therefore, at the time of the ascent of the MAN of ZON to Aba and Ima, for the sake of the Mochin of the separation, ZA is discerned as sleeping, for his brains departed and ascended as MAN to Aba and Ima. But Leah is discerned as awake, for she receives there immediately these Mochin of the separation, namely the Binot and Gevurot of Aba and Ima, which are included in Ima; and Leah, who is included in Ima at the time of the ascent of the MAN, receives them immediately, and descends with them below, to her place, and is sawed apart from ZA — that is, by receiving these Mochin of AB, she becomes a Partzuf separate in itself. For beforehand, in the Mochin of SAG, she had only the aspect of the concealed Hassadim of the GAR of Ima, like the Mochin of ZA himself; and since she was equal to him in the kind of Mochin, she was discerned as though attached to him. But now that Leah received the aspect of the Mochin of revealed Hassadim, from the AB of Ima, by the ascent of the MAN, she is separated from the aspect of the Mochin of ZA. For the Mochin of ZA are always in the aspect of concealed Hassadim, and even at the time of his attainment of the Mochin of AB; except that he is then made in the aspect of the final MEM of Tzelem, which bestows the illumination of Hochma to the LAMED of Tzelem, even though he himself is only the aspect of concealed Hassadim, as is well explained in Part 13, see there. However, Leah, after she received the Binot and Gevurot of Aba and Ima, was made into revealed Hassadim, like the LAMED of Tzelem; therefore she is now found to have been sawed apart from ZA. And this matter has already been explained above, in the Mochin of face to face of midnight, that Leah receives from ZA, when Leah then receives the vessels of Rachel as a loan; this is necessary for her, because she receives the Mochin in the long NHY of Ima, meaning the Mochin of AB, which are long, for long means Hochma. See there.

items.html: And behold, the reason why the Nukva Leah is discerned as awake is because she descends immediately with the Mochin of the separation that she received, and is sawed apart from ZA; and since she has Mochin, she is discerned as awake, as above. But ZA himself does not descend below until he also receives there the Mochin belonging to Rachel, for Rachel cannot receive the Mochin immediately, in the Hall of Aba and Ima, like Leah, because she is an offshoot of ZA, and Aba and Ima are considered the higher upper ones of Rachel, as is known. Therefore Rachel does not receive the Mochin except after ZA awakes from his sleep, namely after ZA descends below, to his place, and bestows them to her; and this descent of ZA is made by the shofar blast, on Rosh Hashanah; then Rachel receives the Mochin of the separation from ZA, in the manner of the degree. Therefore Leah is discerned as awake, and not sleeping, for she received immediately the Mochin fit for her. But ZA, who needs to bestow the Mochin to the Nukva Rachel, does not descend from there except after the shofar blast; and then he awakes and bestows the Mochin to Rachel. Thus, what is said, that at the time of the dormita the female is not asleep, revolves only on the Nukva Leah, since she receives the Mochin immediately and descends below. But in Rachel this does not operate, as above, for she descends equally with ZA, at the time of the shofar blast, as explained (in Item 122).

items.html: (To the question) And what the Rav wrote above in Item 163: When Bina and Gevura departed from ZA, then they illuminated in the Nukva Leah in the secret of a surrounding light, and from there it is drawn to the Malchut Rachel, and they are not asleep like ZA — from which it is implied that Rachel also is not asleep — the intention is on the aspect of the vessels of Rachel that join to Leah, from midnight until morning; from this aspect one can say that Rachel also receives the Mochin immediately, at the time of the ascent of the MAN, namely by the lending of her vessels to Leah (as above, Part 14, Item 35). However, this receiving is not discerned by the name of the building of the Partzuf of Rachel, for Rachel needs to receive the Mochin by means of ZA, namely after his awakening from his sleep, in the secret of the shofar blast, and not by means of Leah, as the Rav wrote above in Item 163. Rather, it revolves on the vessels of Rachel that join to the Partzuf of Leah, at the time that Leah receives the long NHY of Ima; at that time Rachel is found receiving the Mochin by means of Leah, as explained. And what is said, that they illuminate in Leah in the secret of a surrounding light, is because the Mochin of BAN, from their own attribution, are discerned as a surrounding light, as above in Item 179, that they are not discerned as an inner light except from the aspect of their connection with the MAH, because their root is from the lights of Nekudim, which are the aspect of an upper one relative to Atzilut, as said there. And since this receiving is only of Binot and Gevurot alone, therefore they are called a surrounding light. (Items 204, 163, and 122).
